cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
파티 모였네 법사님,
마나약 좀 주셈
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-angled medium shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal Ironforge stone floor shadow. On the left, Dwarf Hunter (blunderbuss rifle stowed on back) casually holds out one open palm with an expectant grin while her cute round 2.5-head chibi SD baby brown bear cub wearing a green scarf sits happily beside her. On the right, Skyborne Mage (crystal staff stowed on back) tilts her head with a puzzled frown.

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
마나 물약은 연금인데
왜 나한테 달래?
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Dwarf Hunter and her cute round 2.5-head chibi SD baby brown bear cub on the left, looking toward Skyborne Mage on the right on a pure #FFFFFF background. Skyborne Mage (staff stowed on back) holds up a small corked blue glass mana potion flask with a genuinely baffled frown while pointing at herself. Dwarf Hunter's shoulders bristle with a comic grumpy aura.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
아이언포지 분들 보세요!
이 법사 마나약 안 줌!
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle wide comic shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal floor shadow. On the left, Dwarf Hunter (blunderbuss stowed on back) climbs atop a small wooden crate waving both arms furiously to rally two tiny cute 2.5-head chibi SD dwarf and gnome villagers nearby while her cute round baby brown bear cub puffs its cheeks beside the crate. On the right, Skyborne Mage (staff on back) freezes in stunned disbelief.

Extreme big bust-up close-up filling 80 percent of frame height on a pure #FFFFFF background. Centered cute 2.5-head chibi SD Skyborne Mage (staff stowed on back) freezes in silent stunned realization with tiny pinpoint pupils, sweat drops, and a dropped jaw, holding a glowing blue corked glass mana water bottle in her left hand and a round conjured loaf of bread in her right hand.

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
설마 쟤 물빵 달라는 걸
마나약이라 한 거임?
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle shot looking down at a small wooden tavern table on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal floor touch. On the left, cute 2.5-head chibi SD Skyborne Mage (staff stowed on back) slumps exhausted over the table beside a corked blue glass water bottle and a round loaf of bread. On the right, cute 2.5-head chibi SD Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde pigtails, zero hairpins, daggers sheathed) listens with raised eyebrows.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
물 마시면 마나 차잖아?
그럼 마나약 맞지 뭐
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile comic finale in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal ground shadow. On the right, cheerful Dwarf Hunter (blunderbuss stowed on back) happily drinks from an open uncorked glowing blue glass water bottle (stopper completely removed) while holding a round loaf of bread as her cute round baby brown bear cub happily munches a mini bread roll beside her. On the left, Skyborne Mage (single crystal staff on back) collapses face-down flat on the ground in total defeat.
